messages:
Diego: Quick async check — wrapping Q2 milestones for eng + product. TL;DR: routing + caching shipped to Dedicated, autoscale knobs still in progress, auto-quant pipeline slipped. Asking owners to confirm shipped bits, list any fallout, and call out blockers for next-week unblock rotations.

Aisha: Shipped: routing policy v1 -> routed 90% of test traffic, no user-facing regressions. Rolled prefix/KV cache into Dedicated pool (canary at 10%). Next: docs + console visibility. @Catalina can you own console tile? :wave:

Catalina: I can take console tile. Will add a per-route latency/cost card and a toggle for canary. ETA -> PR by EOD Wed. 

Ben: CI caught one flaky test related to sequence padding after cache hits. Filed PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/p/4321 (diff small). Quick snippet I used locally to repro:
```
python -m scripts/repro_cache.py --seed 42 --len 2048
```
I think it's safe to patch post-canary but flagging here. @Aisha any tolerance for a hotfix?

Aisha: Let's not hotfix the runtime during canary. Plan: include the patch in the standard release on Friday unless canary shows regression >0.5% latency.

Jun: Note: we observed a transient KV-cache eviction spike yesterday that bumped p95 by ~60ms for 7m. I flagged it in infra-trace and added a short blameless note. If we see recurrence during console rollout we should pause.

Ben: Acknowledged. I'll add a temporary slowdown guard in runtime that disables KV caching if eviction-rate > 0.2/s. Patch in PR 4323.

Catalina: For the console tile, can we show a small banner if feature is in canary and link to the canary cohort? I want PMs to be able to toggle and see who is on it.

Diego: Yes — banner + cohort link is perfect. Also owners: please list next steps for what slipped. Autoscale policy (Optimize) is still blocked by quant infra work and the auto-quant pipeline slipped.

Aisha: Auto-quant pipeline slipped due to toolchain TF upgrade. Ownership: Aisha (PM) + Ben (eng infra) + Priya (ml). Plans: stabilize TF upgrade in a staging job this week, then re-run quant tests. If we can't finish by Fri, move to P1 next week.

Ben: TF upgrade is in progress, but there's a dependency on CUDA driver 530 on the staging nodes. ETA to finish driver roll is Thu afternoon. Will post status.

Jun: FYI, deploy-bot reports the Dedicated canary started 1718765400 and currently at 12% traffic.

deploy-bot: Canary status: started at 1718765400, cohort: dedicated-canary-042, traffic: 12%, errors: 0.03%, p95 delta vs baseline: +12ms.

Diego: Great — action items: 1) Catalina -> console PR (EOD Wed), 2) Ben -> monitor eviction telemetry + PR 4323, 3) Aisha & Priya -> TF/quant rollout plan + contingency, 4) Jun -> keep infra alerts on for p95/regressions and call pause if >0.5% incidence. If anyone wants to sync live, I'll do a 15m standup tomorrow 10:30 PT. Otherwise, please reply here with confirmations. :thumbsup:
